notes.title: REDCON update 2.1
notes.notes:
This minor update introduces perk farming for players who have completed the entire game and continue with replays (referred to as Plus Game Replays).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24319866/84350fee10a38f83944c69eb98fe3bfa929b73ca.png

In Plus Game Replays, your chances of unlocking a new perk are the same as for a regular win but are significantly boosted when you switch the flag from Imperial to Krux.

Happy farming!

notes.title: Major Update 2.0
notes.notes:
The main new feature is the World Map, which allows you to replay levels throughout the campaign. For what it's worth, you can reunite the map under the Krux banner after completing the campaign.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24319866/40673954a877b54828008e02ed7605fcf89395f1.png

Graphics quality has been improved with sharper, clearer visuals and smoother animations. This update brings enhanced support for ultrawide screens and high refresh rates, driving animations from 40-120Hz based on your configuration.

Please note that this update is not compatible with existing mods due to a new resource management system. However, the old version of REDCON is still available on Steam in the legacy channel. Save files for the legacy and new versions are separate, so you can switch between both versions without losing progress.

We've also released a REDCON Demo on Steam. The demo version is limited to 18 missions, and if you decide to purchase the full game, you can continue your progress from the demo.

MOLON LABE!

P.S. You can now observe battles at 3x speed. Double-press F to switch fast-forward from 2x to 3x.
